AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-03-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S.Vantree, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288

Petitioners Joseph Jay Brabant was present in pro per
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Danica Rae Delgado.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court Joseph Jay Flores
